page.overview:
What is Asakusa?

Asakusa belongs to Demon Slayer. It is a large, heavily populated urban center with tall buildings and bright lights that illuminate the city during the night.

Many people walk through crowded marketplaces with dozens of business signs. Unlike Tanjiro Kamado's small town, there are cars of carriages guiding citizens through the roads. There is also a trolley system that runs throughout the city.
